_meta.companion: data/imaging/vst_lbc.md (same content as Markdown). Structure follows data/imaging/widefield.json: sources{key: cite, file, url}; per preset: title, preset (machine-readable explorer inputs), recommended_preset (prose), params, performance (validation targets), not_found, conflicts, notes.
_meta.rule: Every value carries src (key into sources), loc, and a short quote from the saved document (rawdata/imaging/vst/ or rawdata/imaging/lbc/). derived = arithmetic done here from sourced values (shown). alternatives = other sourced values (conflicts). Every quote (main, alternative, figure caption and quotes cited in notes) was machine-checked against the saved file's extracted text: pdftotext -layout and raw for PDFs; tag-stripped text and raw source for HTML; .ini/.ahead as is.
_meta.quote_normalisation: Unicode NFKC; curly quotes, primes, dashes, minus, division slash, tilde operator, soft hyphen, non-breaking spaces, micro sign and white-bullet degree glyphs normalised; whitespace collapsed (a quote also passes if it matches with all whitespace removed); ' ... ' joins non-adjacent pieces.
_meta.figures: Values read from figure images (LBTO LBC layout drawings and optics drawing; Bellini & Bedin 2010 Fig. 1, a raster) cannot be text-checked: each carries a "figure" object with the image file, the annotation as read, the machine-checked caption sentence from the page, and the tesseract OCR evidence.
_meta.frames: Rows are listed top to bottom. VST: Table 2 of the OmegaCAM manual (north up, east right at position angle 0). LBC: LBTO focal-plane drawings and Bellini & Bedin 2010 Fig. 1 (chip #4 on top; chips #3, #2, #1 left to right). x = along a row, y = across rows. Gaps are between light-sensitive areas.

vst_omegacam.title: ESO VLT Survey Telescope (VST) 2.6 m / OmegaCAM (Cassegrain focus of a modified Ritchey-Chretien; two-lens corrector + dewar-window lens; 32 science CCDs)

preset.telescope_type: Cassegrain (modified Ritchey-Chretien: concave hyperbolic M1, convex hyperbolic M2, no tertiary); focus behind the primary
preset.optics: two-lens wide-field corrector (L1, L2) behind the M1 cell, then the filter (inside OmegaCAM), then the dewar entrance window = third lens; ADC + single lens alternative (not offered since P99)
preset.chip_long_axis: along the columns (4100-px axis N-S at position angle 0; the 2048-px axis lies along the rows)
preset.gap_y_note: between rows 1-2, 2-3 and 3-4 counted from the top (north): wide gaps where a readout register faces the neighbouring row, narrow central gap between the two halves

vst_omegacam.recommended_preset: D = 2.61 m (M1 aperture; 2650 mm blank), eps = 0.36 (0.938 m M2 / 2.61 m DERIVED; a lower bound -- the M2 baffle and the "chimney" baffle are not dimensioned in any source found), F = 5.57 = f_eff/D DERIVED (published "f/5.5 modified Ritchey-Chretien"), f_eff = 14,526 mm DERIVED from the manual's 0.213"/px at 15 um for the two-lens corrector (the 0.214"/px of the ESO page gives 14,458 mm; the manual's "1mm=14.3 arcsec" gives 14,424 mm). Telescope: Cassegrain focus of a modified Ritchey-Chretien (concave hyperbolic meniscus M1, convex hyperbolic M2, no tertiary; the two-lens corrector is mounted on the back side of the M1 cell, so the focus lies behind the primary). Primary f/1.82 DERIVED from R = 9509 mm (drawing only; ESO's "(f/3.6)" is R/D). Corrected field 1.47 deg diameter (A10; 1.5 deg in the 1998 design, 1.4 deg in K02 and the manual's "All CCDs fit inside a circle of diameter 1.4 degrees"); 1 deg x 1 deg science array. Optics: direct imager; two-lens corrector (two spherical lenses, L1 and L2) + planar filter + spherical dewar entrance window acting as the third lens, all in the converging beam; an ADC + single-lens corrector exists but has not been offered since P99. Detector: 32 science e2v CCD44-82, 2048 x 4100 used (2048 x 4102 active), 15 um, in 4 rows of 8 (N up, E right at PA 0), 4100-px axis along the columns. Gaps (manual "average gap sizes"): 1.5 mm between the long sides (within a row, 7 per row); between rows 5.64, 0.82, 5.64 mm (top to bottom; the wide gaps carry the readout registers / bond wires). Not science: 4 auxiliary 2k x 4k CCDs (2 guide G1/G2, 2 image-analysis at +/-2 mm from focus) 15.9 mm outside the array. Validate: 0.213"/px (two-lens; 0.214 on the ESO page; 0.215 with ADC), 1 deg x 1 deg, 268 Mpix science (16k x 16k), fill factor 91.4%.

Of the 3 short-side (row) gaps the central one (0.82 mm) separates the two halves, whose 0.16 mm borders face each other; the two wide ones (5.64 mm) lie between rows 1-2 and 3-4, where a 5 mm readout-register border faces the next row (manual: lower-half registers at the south edge, upper half rotated 180 deg; ESO page: "two broader insensitive bands").
chip_gaps.derived: DERIVED: border check -- the two facing 0.16 mm borders account for 0.32 of the 0.82 mm central gap and a 5 mm + 0.16 mm pair for 5.16 of the 5.64 mm wide gaps, leaving ~0.5 mm of mechanical clearance in both. Array 8 x 30.72 + 7 x 1.5 = 256.26 mm by 4 x 61.50 + 2 x 5.64 + 0.82 = 258.10 mm; fill factor 32 x 30.72 x 61.50 / (256.26 x 258.10) = 91.4% -- reproduces the manual's 91.4%. THELI: mean chip pitch along a row 2140.8 px -> gap 92.8 px (82-102 over 28 pairs); row-to-row gaps between active areas 361.5, 51.3, 360.9 px, taking the active rows to start at raw row 1 (CUTY=3 rows) or 101 (CUTY=102 rows, below 100 overscan rows).

Gaps: 1.5 / 0.82 / 5.64 mm and 21.5" / 11.8" / 80.5" (MAN) vs 1.5 mm and 5.7 mm, 25 and 85 arcsec (EOI) vs on-sky 1.39 / 0.77 / 5.42 mm (THELI astrometric header, DERIVED). The MAN arcsec values imply 0.214-0.215"/px (100 px = 21.5", 376 px = 80.5").

Corrected field diameter: 1.47 deg (A10) vs 1.5 deg (A98, 1998 design) vs 1.4 deg (K02; MAN "All CCDs fit inside a circle of diameter 1.4 degrees") vs "1 degree unvignetted field of view" (MAN, i.e. the 1 x 1 deg array).
M1 diameter: 2.61 m aperture (CS11, EPV, A10) vs 2.65 m blank (EPM) vs 2.6 m nominal (MAN, EVS).
Mirror "focal ratios": EPM lists M1 "(f/3.6)" and M2 "(f/4.7)", which are R/D; the M1 focal ratio is f/1.82 (DERIVED, R/2D).
Total pixels: 268 Mpix science (MAN) vs "300-megapixel" / "almost 300 million" (K11, includes the 4 auxiliary CCDs: 302 Mpix DERIVED).
notes: Explorer mapping: rows [8, 8, 8, 8], chips 2048 px along the row and 4100 px across (long axis along the columns), 1.5 mm gaps within a row; row gaps 5.64, 0.82, 5.64 mm top to bottom. With D = 2.61 m and F = 5.565 (f_eff = 14,526 mm) the explorer reproduces 0.213"/px at 15 um; with the published f/5.5 it gives 0.2155"/px (the ADC value is 0.215).
Doc number: the manual's title page reads VST-MAN-OCM-23110-3110 while the ESO file name is VST-MAN-OCM-23100-3110.

lbt_lbc_blue.title: LBT 8.4 m (SX) / LBC-Blue (prime focus, 6-lens fused-silica corrector incl. cryostat window; 4 science CCDs)

preset.eps_note: lower bound (M1 hole); LBC-body shadow not published
preset.telescope_type: prime focus with Wynne-type corrector (5 fused-silica lenses + cryostat-window meniscus); filters between L5 and L6
preset.chip_long_axis: bottom row (chips #3, #2, #1 left to right): long (4608-px) axis along the columns; top row: chip #4 rotated 90 deg, long axis along the row
preset.top_chip_offset_note: centred per LBTO / R16; BB10 Fig. 1 and Table 4 put it 75-77 px (1.0 mm) toward chip #3
preset.pixel_scale_kind: measured at the chip-2 reference point, ~2.3 arcmin from the rotator axis (BB10); the explorer value from f_eff is 0.2286

lbt_lbc_blue.recommended_preset: D = 8.4 m (one LBT primary, nominal; 8.417 m physical), eps = 0.106 is only a lower bound (0.889 m M1 central hole / 8.417 m); the shadow of the LBC body on its swing arm sets the real obscuration and is NOT FOUND. F = 1.45 and f_eff = 12,180 mm (G08: "The focal length of the optical corrector is 12180mm and the final focal ratio is F/1.45"; 12180/8400 = 1.450). Telescope: prime focus of the parabolic F/1.142 primary, no secondary or tertiary; the LBC hangs on the SX prime-focus swing arm. Corrector: Wynne-type, 5 fused-silica lenses (L1 810 mm) + the cryostat window (positive meniscus, almost no power) = 6 lenses; two filter wheels between L5 and L6; derotator carries filters + cryostat. Direct imager. Corrected field 110 mm diameter = 0.52 deg DERIVED (R16; LBTO drawing "Corrected field 5% (Ø=110mm)", 0% vignetting inside Ø 102.8 mm); G08 quotes ~30' corrected and 27' unvignetted. Detector: 4 science e2v CCD42-90, 2048 x 4608, 13.5 um. Rows (top to bottom, centred): [1, 3] -- chip #4 rotated 90 deg on top (long axis along the row), chips #3, #2, #1 below (long axis along the columns). Gaps (G08): 1.0 mm (74 px, 16.7") between the three vertical chips, 1.03 mm (76 px, 17.2") between them and chip #4. On-sky (BB10, DERIVED): 62 / 65 px and 52 px (0.84 / 0.88 / 0.70 mm). Not science: 2 technical CCDs left and right of the array (guide beside #1, extra-focal -0.8 mm beside #3). Validate: 0.2297"/px measured at chip-2 reference near the field centre (BB10; 0.2286 DERIVED from 12,180 mm), 0.2254-0.2255"/px field average (G08, BB10 median, LBTO); 23.6' x 25.3' (G08); 4 x 2048 x 4608 = 37.7 Mpix DERIVED.
